headline: Status Yellow - Rain warning for Clare, Cork, Donegal, Galway, Kerry, Leitrim, Limerick, Mayo, Sligo
description:
Storm Boelo will bring spells of heavy rain. 

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Difficult travelling conditions
  • Localised flooding possible
  • Outdoor events impacted

headline: Status Yellow - Wind warning for Connacht, Clare, Kerry, Limerick
description:
Storm Boelo: Very strong southwest winds will veer westerly with severe gusts and coastal gales. 

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Debris, loose objects displaced
  • Difficult driving and cycling conditions
  • Large coastal waves
  • Some fallen trees, branches
  • Outdoor events impacted

headline: Status Orange - Rain warning for Galway, Kerry
description:
Storm Boelo will bring spells of very heavy rain. 

Possible Impacts:

  • Damage to homes and businesses possible
  • Disruption and delays to public transport (rail, bus)
  • Flooding expected
  • Outdoor events disrupted
  • Difficult travelling conditions

headline: Status Orange - Wind warning for Donegal, Galway, Leitrim, Mayo, Sligo
description:
Storm Boelo: Gale force westerly winds with severe and damaging gusts.

Prepare for impacts:

  • Damage to already weakened structures
  • Damage to power lines, power outages
  • Disruption and delays to public transport likely (air, rail, bus, ferry)
  • Fallen trees
  • Large coastal waves
  • Loose objects displaced
  • Coastal flooding where winds onshore
  • Very difficult travelling conditions, dangerous conditions at sea
